messages:
Maya: Heads-up 1: planning the post-webinar newsletter + launch nurture. Goal: convert registrants -> product trial + webinar-to-content funnel. Need 4 emails over 10 days, with segmentation by product intent tag (benchmarks, cost, infra).

Jorge: Flow idea: 1) Thank you + watch link (immediate). 2) Highlight clip + bench TL;DR (day 2). 3) Use-case carousel + CTA to sandbox (day 5). 4) Pricing + invite to office hours (day 10). Personalize by intent tag and company size.

Nina: Segments: 
- intent=benchmarks -> emphasize latency/cost metrics and short code snippets
- intent=infra -> emphasize private/dedicated options and security blurb
- intent=cost -> highlight Optimize recommendations + unit cost numbers
Add suppression for unsubscribed and recent non-openers (last 30d) on follow-ups.

Oliver: Deliverability notes: use seed pool + ISP checks before Day 0 full send. Ramp: 2% -> 20% -> 100% across 24h. Add header: List-Unsubscribe and canonical unsubscribe link. Also add click tracking whitelisting in CDN.

Priya: Localization: JP/KR/DE required for segments >500. Provide copy by Wed EOD for translations. Also request localized send windows for EMEA and APAC: EMEA target 09:00-11:00 CET, APAC 08:00-10:00 SGT.

Maya: Creative asks: 2 subject line bundles per segment (short + curiosity). Example subjects:
- benchmarks: "Benchmark: 3x faster inference in production" / "Benchmark highlights: latency & cost wins"
- infra: "How Redwood keeps inference private at scale" / "Dedicated inference for regulated workloads"
- cost: "Reduce per-token cost without losing quality" / "How we cut inference TCO"
Include preheader variations. Set up subject A/B on emails 1 & 3 for high-volume segments.

Jorge: Tracking: append UTM params by segment. Example: ?utm_campaign=webinar_launch_3060001112&utm_source=email&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_content=benchmarks_A. Also add header X-Experiment: webinar_nurture_v1 for A/B traffic. Provide tracking table in the doc.

Nina: KPI targets: Open > 28% (Starter), CTR > 5% (Growth), Demo requests 1% (Enterprise). Monitor unsubscribe delta after each send; roll back variant if >0.6% uplift.

Oliver: QA checklist: links (watch, docs, sandbox), mobile rendering, BMP images optimized, dark-mode checks, unsub links, SPF/DKIM alignment. Meeting Wed 15:00 PT for pre-send QA.

LaunchBot: Reminder: Email QA meeting Wed 15:00 PT. Calendar invite sent. :calendar:

Maya: I'll draft bundle copy and subject variants today and drop in the doc. Assignments: Jorge 1) build suppression/export lists, 2) set up ramp in ESP. Nina 1) finalize segment definitions and tracking tags. Oliver 1) run seed and deliverability report. Priya 1) localization coord.

Jorge: Copy of the export queries and an example UTM mapping table added to: https://docs.redwood.xyz/marketing/newsletter/3060001112 (private). Snippet: ```sql
-- Export: bench intent, company_size <=50
SELECT email FROM users WHERE intent = 'benchmarks' AND company_size <= 50 AND email_opt_in = true;
```

Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll post final send schedule and creative links here when ready. :sparkles:
